summary: Verified Fee Structure changes (Issue 1: June/March editable + arbitrary month skip via zero override; Issue 2: student fee-assignment now syncs with main plan timeline). Backend: 4/4 NEW pytest in test_fee_plan_month_overrides.py PASS — POST /api/fees/plans with month_amounts overrides for June (₹2500 charge) and May (₹0 skip) creates a plan whose GET /api/fees/plans/{id}/installments returns exactly: March=skip/₹0, May=skip/₹0, June=active/₹2500, 9 other months active/₹5000 each — total ₹47,500. Plain 50000 plan yields 10x₹5000 with June & March skip. Overrides persist on the plan doc. RBAC enforced (unauth => 401). Existing regression suite backend/tests/test_stanvard_real_seed.py 23/23 PASS after fixing REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env. Frontend Playwright as admin@stanvard.school: (Issue 1 UI) Add Fee Plan dialog — Tuition Fee 50000 monthly item → all 12 month-amount-N inputs editable, June(6)/March(3) show blank+placeholder 0 with 'No Fee' caption, other months prefilled ₹5000. Typing 2500 into June turns cell amber and Net annual goes ₹50,000 → ₹47,500 (with -₹2,500 shown as 'Total discount'), Monthly summary refreshes. Typing 0 into May shows 'Skipped' caption. Save → reopen → June=2500, May=0 both persisted; deleted TEST plan cleanly. (Issue 2 sync UI) Opened existing plan-based assignment for KNP student, switched to 'Use Existing Fee Plan' → Class II — FY 2026-27 Tuition Plan → Net Payable ₹24,500, Monthly Installment ₹2,450, timeline shows installment-amount-4..12,1,2 = ₹2450 each (10 rows, June+March omitted), sum = ₹24,500 exactly = Net Payable → structure↔student are in sync. (Regression) Parent portal /parent/pay for mobile 6376066570 shows April Paid, May Partial, June 2026 = 'No fee this month', March 2027 = 'No fee this month'. Dashboard, Students (375 rows), Fee Structures (13 seeded plans) all load without errors.

rca of the issue: Original bug 'clash between main fee structure and student fee assignment': RCA was that AssignFeeDialog rebuilt installments from saved data OR did an internal equal-split of the netPayable without consulting the actual plan's per-month timeline, so if the plan had month_amounts overrides or the student had concession, the two views showed different numbers. Fix (already applied by main agent): AssignFeeDialog now fetches GET /api/fees/plans/{plan_id}/installments, scales each active month by (netPayable / planTimelineTotal), and edit-mode drops stale saved installments for plan-based assignments. Verified via UI that timeline sum matches Net Payable exactly (₹24,500 = 10 × ₹2,450) and June/March correctly show as No Fee both in the plan editor and the student's assignment dialog.
